items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: From Mercury we went to Columbia, with Mitch Miller. ... Mitch Miller was the musical diretior or the producer of Mercury..... So we went to Columbia with Mitch Miller and he record with us "Hobo Mambo"

ctx.x: Continental, and from Verne we went to - no to Mercury, and from Mercury we went with Mitch Miller. Mitch Miller joined Columbia, worked for Columbia, and then we finished with Columbia. We made all - - two-year contract we had with Columbia we made in one month, because they want to discontinue the Latin department in the United States, so from there we made a recording with Tico.
Okay, we are getting ahead of ourselves.
